messages.text:
Your previous carafe refund proposal expired because proposals are valid for only 72 hours. Once expired, a new proposal is needed. (refund-policy/v2/validity)

I’ve created a new proposal for **BRL 119.90**. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a typed “yes” does not count. A staff member must then approve it before payment. (refund-policy/v2/amount) (refund-policy/v2/approval)

A debit-card refund can be paid automatically to the original payment if the order has exactly one valid payment record—but it still requires your confirmation and staff approval. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/approval) In this demo, the receipt records a refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer, and no card-credit date is promised. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
